M1_PICR.responsibility: infer source identity while separating transport, source-strength and sensor nuisance

inputs.frames: ordered list of {stamp_ns, pose_xy, gas_ppm, local_wind_uv} through current time only
inputs.candidates: arbitrary current-map free source cells or regions

outputs.source_representation: nuisance-invariant representation used by candidate scorer
outputs.amplitude_state: source-strength/release nuisance estimate or distributional state
outputs.abstain_reason: explicit reason when evidence contract is insufficient

M2_CPO.responsibility: predict action-intervention-conditioned future observation law for one source hypothesis

inputs.source_hypothesis: one candidate cell/region, marginalized over a frozen placement quadrature when region-valued
inputs.sparse_local_wind_history: causally stamped wind observations at executed poses; no full field required
inputs.gas_sensor_state: causal history summary and audited FOPDT state
inputs.future_route: physically legal candidate route sampled at the frozen prediction cadence

outputs.first_hit_prob: length H+1 categorical law for T=1..H and T>H

M3_PHS.responsibility: choose the future intervention that most separates currently competing source hypotheses

inputs.route_laws: M2 categorical future law for every source x route

outputs.tie_break_metadata: travel/index deterministic resolution of exact score ties

closed_loop_order: M1 updates source posterior from executed observations
M2 predicts source-conditioned law under do(route)
M3 selects route from M1 posterior and M2 laws
new actual observations return to M1

incremental_arms.F00: PICR + native PMFS information planner via coefficient-free posterior-to-native-weight adapter
incremental_arms.F10: PICR + PHS + frozen baseline route-law provider
